sections.h2: Solar sits in the lowest certificate tier, with a multiplier of 1 like wind

chart.title: Biomass earns 2.5 certificates per MWh, while solar and wind earn 1
chart.sub: Certificate Multiplier under CERC's 2022 REC Regulations, by technology.

sections.means: Solar gets the lowest multiplier, so one MWh of solar generation yields one certificate, the same as on-shore wind.
sections.todo: Check the multiplier table before assuming a hydro or biomass plant earns the same certificates as solar.
